SIGNAL_MATCHED_NORMALIZATION.reason: B100 and C1000 have different effective PDF/alpha_s running. C1000 is not the declared future CTEQ6L1 one-loop target; matched integration/convergence and its physical rate uncertainty remain unavailable.
SIGNAL_MATCHED_NORMALIZATION.future_requirement: Separately authorized corrected matched integration, independently validated cross section/error, corrected event chain, immutable new source identities; do not rescale or replace historical events silently.

HEAVY_FLAVOUR_BACKGROUND_EXCLUSIVITY.reason: B01/B02/B03 reconstructed phase-space sharing or ancestry labels do not establish perturbative ME/PS exclusivity.
HEAVY_FLAVOUR_BACKGROUND_EXCLUSIVITY.future_requirement: Matched/merged generation or a validated generator-level exclusive definition, with uncertainty and source-level closure.

FAKE_PHOTON_ESTIMATION.reason: B06 contains one Born photon and zero final survivors; neither is a calibrated jet-to-photon fake estimate. Missing fake rate is null, not zero.
FAKE_PHOTON_ESTIMATION.future_requirement: Applicable public/data-derived fake transfer factor with object/period/energy/region definitions, composition, contamination, uncertainty, correlations and closure.

SINGLE_HIGGS_MODELING.reason: ZH and ttH have correctly applied own MODEL_BR_ONLY factors; physical normalization, top-decay/spin assumptions and modeling uncertainties are not fully validated.
SINGLE_HIGGS_MODELING.future_requirement: Review process/decay/BR convention and single-Higgs normalization, topology, spin correlations, generator/PS systematics.

DETECTOR_CALIBRATION.reason: Native Delphes bit0/kinematics closure validates this fast-simulation implementation; it does not supply official detector object efficiencies, scales, resolution, trigger or pileup calibrations.
DETECTOR_CALIBRATION.future_requirement: Compatible detector/object calibrations and independently established selection applicability.

SYSTEMATIC_NUISANCE_VALUES.reason: All 22 physical nuisance values/constraints are unavailable; synthetic widths are method inputs only.
SYSTEMATIC_NUISANCE_VALUES.future_requirement: Traceable process/object/rate/shape physical values, units, constraints and validation.

NUISANCE_CORRELATIONS.reason: No validated physical nuisance correlation model across processes, objects, bins or data periods. Common-source kappa statistical covariance does not replace systematic correlations.
NUISANCE_CORRELATIONS.future_requirement: Reviewed correlation matrix/model with provenance, PSD/constraint and likelihood closure checks.

MC_BIN_STATISTICAL_SUPPORT.reason: B02 final 1/1000, B03/B06 final 0/1000 and empty/low-ESS bins prevent reliable finely binned physical templates; kappa 2.5/5 remain under-supported.
MC_BIN_STATISTICAL_SUPPORT.future_requirement: Predeclared bins with sufficient independent proposal support, rare-event interval/planning diagnostics, validated finite-MC likelihood and independent source checks.

SIGNED_EXPECTATION_MODEL_IF_APPLICABLE.reason: The present raw source cohorts have0 negative-weight events. Phase8 rejects unsupported signed physical templates. This conditional check does not establish support for future signed inputs.
SIGNED_EXPECTATION_MODEL_IF_APPLICABLE.future_requirement: If future negative contributions occur, validate a signed estimator/expectation model; reject unsupported rates, retain signs, and never replace negatives with zero.

Phase7I_dependency: TRACKED_ONLY_NO_BUILD_OR_RESTART; future corrected matched integration and event chain require separate authorization
